documents.title: Bambu PLA Tough+ Technical Data Sheet (Bambu Filament TDS V3.0)
Bambu PLA Tough+ Safety Data Sheet SDS20250928A10 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Tough+
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 20.9 ± 1 MPa, elongation 9.3 ± 3 %, bending modulus 2066 ± 100 MPa, bending strength 54 ± 4 MPa, impact 25.9 ± 3.3 kJ/m² and 18.6 ± 2.3 kJ/m² marked "(Silver)") are not stored. Raw-material properties (density, DSC melting and glass transition) sit in material.* / thermal.* keys.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1860 ± 70 MPa, Z 1920 ± 20 MPa), melt index (18.0 ± 2.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), saturated water absorption rate (0.27% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 – 45 °C), max overhang angle (55 °), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. Nozzle sizes, AMS compatibility, support material and glue are kept as relations.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 – 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A10-xx", composition (polylactic acid 80-90 %, additive 10-20 % by wt), CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 220 - 250 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C for PLA*); AMS drying (TDS "AMS 2 Pro & AMS HT : 55 °C，8 h" vs material-table wiki 45 ℃ for 12 h for PLA); HDT (PLA wiki 57°C for PLA in general vs TDS 58 °C at 1.8 MPa and 61 °C at 0.45 MPa). The product TDS values are kept; only the oven drying values are stored.
Marketing prose proves no number: "toughness on par with ABS", "up to 2× stronger layer adhesion than standard PLA", "outlasts standard PLA" (store page) are not stored.

Hex: the hex table names all 7 store colours exactly once ("White" ↔ "White (12107)", "Gray" ↔ "Gray (12105)", "Black" ↔ "Black (12104)", "Silver" ↔ "Silver (12106)", "Yellow" ↔ "Yellow (12401)", "Cyan" ↔ "Cyan (12601)", "Orange" ↔ "Orange (12301)"); values read from the text layer and checked against the rendered page.

material.spool_type is neither stored nor marked not_published: no source names the spool (no "Comes with … Spool" bullet; the TDS gives only spool material and size), and the Spool option group ("Filament with Spool" / "Refill") carries the choice.

The store page links documents that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/s1/default/99010e5feaf343c59a358bef3e4c3eea/Bambu_PLA_Tough_RoHS.pdf) and the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool. safety.certifications is therefore neither stored nor marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.
